item.title: Redis Distributed Practice (Part 4): Cluster Architecture, Online Resharding, and Python Client Development
item.description: Part 4 of the Redis Distributed Practice series: In-depth analysis of the Redis Cluster 16384 hash slots sharding mechanism and decentralized Gossip protocol, hands-on deployment of a 7000~7005 six-node distributed cluster, live horizontal scaling with 800 slots resharding, graceful node decommissioning, and Python client integration with standalone instances, Sentinel read/write splitting, and Redis Cluster with compatibility pitfall solutions.

item.title: Redis High Availability Practice (Part 3): Master-Replica Replication and Sentinel Automatic Failover
item.description: Part 3 of the Redis High Availability Practice series: In-depth analysis of the Redis Master-Replica replication mechanism (full BGSAVE synchronization, continuous command propagation, and repl_backlog circular buffer incremental resume), critical warnings against slave data wipeout accidents caused by unpersisted masters, hands-on deployment of a 6380/6381/6382 three-instance replication topology on a single host, and implementation of Sentinel clusters for sub-second subjective/objective down detection, Leader election, and automated failover.
